nodes.label: Graphical Excellence
nodes.description: The well-designed presentation of interesting data—a matter of substance, of statistics, and of design. Consists of complex ideas communicated with clarity, precision, and efficiency.

nodes.label: Graphical Integrity
nodes.description: Telling the truth about the data. Avoiding distortions and deceptive designs.

nodes.label: Lie Factor
nodes.description: Size of effect shown in graphic divided by size of effect in data. Should be around 1.0.

nodes.label: Design Variation vs Data Variation
nodes.description: Changes in the graphic should reflect changes in data, not changes in design.

nodes.label: Context
nodes.description: Graphics must not quote data out of context.
